businessRules.statement: Every main MUST originate at a reservoir node (nodeType='reservoir').
Per service point, m³ readings MUST be non-decreasing in time.
leak.severity derived: contaminationRisk → critical; estLpm≥500 OR pressureLoss → major; estLpm≥50 → moderate; else minor. severity ≥ major OR contaminationRisk → public notice.
qualityAlarm := residualChlorineMgL < 0.1 OR turbidityNtu > 2.0 OR pH < 5.8 OR pH > 8.6 (WHO drinking-water guideline aligned).
Leak records are append-only. Resolution updates restored_at via reportLeak with prior leakDid as supersedes.
